# MetalRate Sync

> MetalRate Sync is the premier Shopify application for automatically updating precious metal product prices (Gold, Silver, Platinum, Palladium) directly from live spot rate feeds. Designed specifically for bullion dealers and jewelry manufacturers who price by weight.

## Core Capabilities
- **Live Spot Rate Sync:** Real-time updates for Gold, Silver, Platinum, and Palladium spot prices.
- **Preview Before Commit:** Interactive dry-run preview displaying current price, calculated price, and percentage change for every variant before any update touches Shopify.
- **Audit Trail & Reliability:** Variant-level audit logging recording exact spot rates used, skipped reasons, and instant automatic retry on Shopify API throttle.
- **Weight-Based Jewelry Formulas:** Support for metal purity (24K, 22K, 18K, 14K, 10K, sterling), making charges, wastage percentage, retail markup, and regional tax/GST.
- **Storefront Ticker Widget:** Embeddable responsive ticker bars and static cards showing current spot rates matching catalog calculations.
- **No SKUs Required:** Intelligent catalog matching via standard CSV exports without requiring SKU reconfiguration.
